decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line bug-fix note [ev-4b121944161e]: Karpenter now makes sure EbsOptimizedInfo exists when it selects instances by EBS maximum bandwidth. The note does not say what went wrong before the fix (a crash, an error, or the wrong instances chosen), and it does not say what an operator would see after it. The proposed statement says environments "will no longer encounter failures", but the evidence never mentions failures, so neither behavior-change nor a medium severity is supported. The other Bug Fixes items in the section context add nothing. Deciding this needs the PR #6663 description or diff, or an upgrade-guide entry that describes the symptom.
